info.title: HandUp API
info.description: REST API for HandUp (docs/PRD.md). Responses use { data } or { error: { code, message } }. The **Public API** (/api/v1/public/**) is for course sites and bots: create a key at /settings/api-keys and send it as X-API-Key. It only reads sessions you host, never shows hidden questions or anonymous names, and allows any origin (CORS).
